title: Immutable CLI release updates
description: The active connection relay and manual update reuse the public installer. It builds a private uv tool environment for each release, installs it with a child-only umask 022, checks every credential-helper source with the release's own guard, evicts only the yoke-cli and yoke-contracts uv cache entries and reinstalls once when cached sources are group- or other-writable, verifies the candidate and atomically publishes a launcher pointer. Commands hold file leases and keep importing their original release while the next command uses the new one. Retired environments are removed after leases and process inspection show no remaining users. A failed candidate preserves the active release; cleanup refusal names the recovery. Source launcher and uninstall use the same owner.
